import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'product': ['Laptop', 'Mouse', 'Keyboard', 'Monitor', 'Cable'],
    'price': [999.99, 25.50, 79.00, 249.00, 9.99],
    'in_stock': [True, True, False, True, True],
})

affordable = df[(df['price'] < 100) & (df['in_stock'] == True)]
print(affordable)
